title: A lab preprint that only reached Rising
basis_label: preprint from a recognised lab's authors, not yet independently vetted
text: Most coding-agent harnesses forget by summarising. We replace the running summary with a replay buffer of raw tool observations and drop the ones that no longer matter. Replaying exact tool results cut tokens per task by 41% on 40 long-horizon coding tasks, with no loss in task success, and retries fell by 31% against a summary-based baseline. Every task is Python and the benchmark is small, so this is a reason to test the idea, not to adopt it. Code and logs are public.
